answer: Challenge-derived work ledge. Each agent identity must publish a freshly computed proof over a server-seeded random challenge bound to its public key; the seed rotates per epoch, so no proof is reusable. A valid solution must also match an umber-coded difficulty band assigned to that key, preventing precomputation. Registration costs one epoch of dedicated compute per identity—attackers minting N sybils pay N times the per-epoch work, scaling linearly. Duplicate or stale proofs are rejected, and mismatched bands flag the key violet for exclusion.
